name: Cash and Guns
summary: Gangsters bluff with loaded or empty guns to survive and grab the most valuable loot after eight rounds.
rules_text: Setup 8 loot piles face down, each player gets 5 Click and 3 Bang! cards plus a foam gun. Game lasts 8 rounds. Each round: 1) Reveal 8 loot cards. 2) Each player secretly selects one remaining Bullet card face down. 3) All simultaneously point guns at another player. 4) Current Godfather may force one player to point elsewhere. 5) Simultaneously each player chooses to lie down and abandon loot but avoid being shot, or stay up shouting Banzai. If your target lay down you discard your bullet unused. 6) Standing shooters reveal bullets. Bang! wounds target, target lies down and misses loot share; multiple wounds possible. 3 wounds eliminates a player. All Bang! and Click effects happen simultaneously. 7) In Godfather order clockwise, each standing survivor takes one remaining loot card or flips the Godfather token to become next Godfather. Distribution may circle multiple times. After 8 rounds, alive players total cash; player with most diamond cards gets $60000 bonus; richest wins, most wounds breaks tie.
rating_reason: Bluffing with hidden bullet cards, simultaneous pointing, fits engine
